immutable_subject: Stale fencing-token rejection was over-classified as a system terminal hold rather than normal stale-writer rejection.
observed_failure: When an epoch fencing token from an older writer was presented, the system placed the entire consensus engine into TERMINAL_HOLD instead of safely rejecting the stale writer and allowing current epoch to proceed.
canonical_invariant_violated: STALE_FENCING_SAFETY_ISOLATION: Stale fencing tokens must be rejected without mutating state or triggering a global terminal governance halt.
root_cause: Fencing token mismatch was treated as a fatal ledger corruption event rather than expected concurrency fencing behavior.
contributing_causes: Overly broad fail-closed assertion on any fencing divergence
required_behavior: Stale fence raises StaleFencingTokenError resulting in STALE_WRITER_REJECTED while current epoch state remains active and healthy.
implementation_scope: Define StaleFencingTokenError and STALE_WRITER_REJECTED outcome in transactional_state_backend.py
Prevent epoch transition or global hold on stale write rejection
planned_fix: Classify stale fence as STALE_WRITER_REJECTED and isolate rejection to writer without halting engine.
planned_negative_control: Submit write with fence N when engine is at N+1; verify write rejected, engine remains active at N+1, and no terminal hold is set.
planned_causal_ablation: Trigger global terminal hold on stale fence; verify test detects false terminal hold.
